_comment: Persistent-loopback gates for examples/pricing-api under the production profile. #99 adds the distinct-account and mixed-saturation scenarios; their two p50 ratios stay null until a calibrated controlled-host run records them, while the shed thresholds gate everywhere because they are comparative: they ask whether the reserve changed the outcome, not how fast the machine is. Request counts are totals per scenario. Absolute latency ceilings and throughput floors are provisional controlled-laptop bounds; each admitted-vs-baseline p50 ratio is portable only when its configured connection count is held constant.
